verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM is an AI assistant and agent platform, so multi-device control is a fair question for it. However, the evidence pack documents only a single-device, run-on-your-computer assistant, plus multi-user server hosting. Nothing shows pairing phones or other computers for screenshots, camera, notifications or media playback. Custom agent skills and MCP compatibility are developer building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As a power user, the assistant reaches beyond one machine — paired phones and computers it can use for screenshots, camera, notifications, or media playback
